slides.title: Lifecycle Hooks (Preview) 🔄
slides.content:
Vue instances have **lifecycle hooks** – special methods that run at different stages:

- `created()` – runs when the instance is created.
- `mounted()` – runs after the DOM is rendered.
- `updated()` – runs after data changes.

We'll explore these in depth later!

quizData.question: In a Vue instance, what is the purpose of the `data` option?

options.text: To define reactive properties that trigger UI updates when changed

quizData.explanation: `data` is a function that returns an object of reactive properties. Vue tracks these properties and updates the DOM whenever they change.
